target.title: fix(video-generation): bound stalled video download response body
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`readResponseWithLimit()` in video/music generation provider download paths capped `maxBytes` but omitted `chunkTimeoutMs`. A server that accepts the connection and then stops sending body chunks can leave the download Promise pending indefinitely, exhausting the Gateway connection pool under concurrent video downloads.

## Why This Change Was Made

Wire `chunkTimeoutMs` + `onIdleTimeout` on every video/music download path that was missing them, matching `google/video-generation-provider.ts` and `anthropic/usage.ts`. Resolve `ProviderOperationTimeoutMs` (`number | () => number`) to a concrete number before passing it to `chunkTimeoutMs` so TypeScript and the idle timer see a finite budget. Add a caller-path OpenAI regression that feeds a never-chunking `ReadableStream` body and asserts the production download error within the request deadline.

## User Impact

**Before:** A stalled upstream video/music download body could hang the provider download forever.

**After:** Download body reads fail closed after the operation idle budget with a clear `…download stalled: no data received for Nms` error, releasing the connection.

## Changed Files

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `extensions/openai/video-generation-provider.ts` | Add `chunkTimeoutMs` via `resolveOpenAIVideoDownloadTimeoutMs` + `onIdleTimeout` |
| `extensions/byteplus/video-generation-provider.ts` | Add `resolveBytePlusVideoDownloadTimeoutMs` + `chunkTimeoutMs` + `onIdleTimeout` |
| `extensions/runway/video-generation-provider.ts` | Add `resolveRunwayVideoDownloadTimeoutMs` + `chunkTimeoutMs` + `onIdleTimeout` |
| `extensions/together/video-generation-provider.ts` | Add `resolveTogetherVideoDownloadTimeoutMs` + `chunkTimeoutMs` + `onIdleTimeout` |
| `extensions/fal/video-generation-provider.ts` | Add `chunkTimeoutMs: DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS` + `onIdleTimeout` |
| `extensions/fal/image-generation-provider.ts` | Add `chunkTimeoutMs: DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS` + `onIdleTimeout` |
| `extensions/openrouter/video-generation-provider.ts` | Add `chunkTimeoutMs: params.timeoutMs` + `onIdleTimeout` |
| `extensions/minimax/video-generation-provider.ts` | Add `chunkTimeoutMs: resolveMinimaxRequestTimeoutMs` + `onIdleTimeout` (both URL and file_id paths) |
| `extensions/minimax/music-generation-provider.ts` | Add `chunkTimeoutMs: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS` + `onIdleTimeout` |
| `src/plugin-sdk/test-helpers/provider-http-mocks.ts` | Wire `createProviderOperationTimeoutResolver` + `resolveProviderOperationTimeoutMs` to honor explicit `deadline.timeoutMs` |
| `extensions/openai/video-generation-provider.test.ts` | Add `stalledVideoResponse()` fixture + caller-path regression |

## Real Behavior Proof

**Key test:** `times out stalled generated video download bodies via chunkTimeoutMs` passes in **85ms** (not 120s default). Stalled `ReadableStream` fixture accepts headers but never enqueues chunks. With `timeoutMs: 80`, the production path rejects with `OpenAI generated video download stalled: no data received for 80ms`.
